sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can consolidate the story of the Árpád dynasty: notable kings, the Golden Bull, the kingdom's consolidation, church and state, and the end of the line in 1301.
I can name the Golden Bull's date (1222) and its basic significance.
I can explain why the Árpád line ended in 1301.
I can review this unit's vocabulary and grammar (the relative clauses aki, amely, ahol, amikor).
